description: Repairs r-cursor-1b/getrows-shape-types (the WD Decimal array): the Decimal column was made through DAO TableDef.CreateField(name, 20), which gives Precision 38 and Scale 0 and which DAO cannot read, so the GetRows array [0+0,0+2] came from an unreadable column. WD(ID INTEGER, Dc DECIMAL(18,4)) was made through ADO DDL with explicit precision and scale and holds (1, 1.5), (2, no Dc), (3, -2.25), (4, 0.0001) written as SQL literals. For a table-type, a dynaset and a snapshot over WD: GetRows(2), then BOF, EOF and ID; GetRows(2) again; BOF, EOF and ID; GetRows(2) at the end; BOF and EOF; close. Then a snapshot over "SELECT ID, Dc FROM WD ORDER BY ID" reads every row's Value. Asks the VARIANT type of a Decimal cell in the GetRows array, the array dimensions per type, and how a Null Decimal appears. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
